endpoints.name: Line Creek
endpoints.coordinateSource: OSM way/171171652 power=substation substation=transmission operator=Georgia Power voltage=230000 (unnamed in OSM; history v1 2012, v7 2026-06-30); adjacent GPC 115/46/12 kV yard way/171171654
endpoints.validation: Unnamed in OSM, so identified from topology, and every check agrees with the plans: (1) it is the only GPC 230 kV transmission station between Palmetto and Fairburn, with GPC 115 kV lines on the Morrow-Yates Common corridor, as gpc:20771 and gpc:18736 require; (2) straight-line distance to the Yates switchyard is 16.2 mi, against SERTP 2025's 16.5 mi 'Yates - Line Creek (Red/Green) 230 kV' lines (sertp-2025-plan p.106 lists Line Creek-Yates, -Union City and -Morrow 230 kV); (3) two new OSM power lines mapped 2026-06-30 (way/1533913749, way/1533913750, about 0.2-0.3 mi each) run from this station to a substation added in 2024 (way/1319980016) 0.33 mi NW, which matches gpc:18736's 'two short lines from Line Creek to Shugart Farms (0.3 miles each)'; (4) Line Creek, the stream, runs about 2.5 km east. It is on Williams Road, Fairburn, Fulton County (Nominatim reverse).

endpoints.name: Gullatt Road (new customer station)
endpoints.coordinateSource: Mean of the centers of the four OSM ways named Gullatt Road in Fairburn, Fulton County (way/42004321 33.5144,-84.6140; way/42004317 33.5268,-84.6144; way/9255613 33.5322,-84.6201; way/9235548 33.5376,-84.6259)
endpoints.validation: This is a new customer station whose exact site is not public; the plan and SERTP 2025 (p.88) place it on the Morrow-Yates Common 115 kV and Line Creek-Fairburn #2 115 kV lines. Gullatt Road runs about 2.8 km N-S between 33.514 and 33.538 N, just east and north of the Line Creek station. The researcher's point was the center of the northern tertiary segment only, not the road midpoint as claimed, so it was recomputed as the mean of all four segments.

projects.notes: The plan also covers rebuilding the Line Creek-Fairburn #2 115 kV line to Gullatt Road, removing the Owens Corning tap, and rebuilding North Coweta - Str 1. The new 2024 OSM substation way/1319980016 is assigned to Shugart Farms (gpc:18736), because new short lines link it to Line Creek.

endpoints.name: Shugart Farms
endpoints.coordinateSource: OSM way/1319980016 power=substation (unnamed, untagged voltage/operator; v1 created 2024-10-01), 0.53 km NW of the Line Creek station
endpoints.validation: New substation first mapped in 2024. projects.notes: Line Creek 230 kV rebuild (breaker-and-a-half), with the Morrow-Yates 230 kV and Union City-Yates 230 kV White lines tied into Line Creek, plus two short (0.3 mi) lines to Shugart Farms. All the work is in a cluster about 1 km across on Williams Rd between Palmetto and Fairburn.

Doyle (GPC 230 kV, way/176906118, 33.8379,-83.6988) is 1.6 km N and the Monroe Switch Station (way/176896777, 33.8137,-83.6949) is 1.1 km S, so the site is between the two ends of the line, as a loop-in requires.
